title: Cosmic Detective with Eye Wheel
description: A surreal portrait of a man in a green trench coat and fedora, holding a pipe and magnifying glass, with his face partially obscured by a large circular wheel containing an oversized realistic human eye at its center. The wheel is marked with repeating letters S, T, G and stylized patterns against a vibrant cosmic background.
prompt: Surreal oil painting of a mysterious detective wearing a green fedora and trench coat, holding a pipe, his face replaced by a large circular wheel with a giant realistic human eye at the center.
